elements.requirement: For the purposes of subsection (2)(c)(iii), a youth rehabilitation order has the meaning given by section 173 of the Sentencing Code.

elements.requirement: Where a child has been removed under Part V or detained under section 38 of the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984, and the child is not being provided with accommodation by a local authority, a local authority in Wales, or in a hospital vested in the Secretary of State or the Welsh Ministers, or otherwise made available pursuant to arrangements made by the Secretary of State, NHS England or an integrated care board under the National Health Service Act 2006 or a Health Authority Local Health Board, any reasonable expenses of accommodating the child are recoverable from the local authority or local authority in Wales in whose area the child is ordinarily resident.
elements.quote: any reasonable expenses of accommodating him shall be recoverable from the local authority , or local authority in Wales, in whose area he is ordinarily resident
